notes:
BUILD 8
- Tools: fists now roll round the handle with the swing, so wrists no longer flip at the ends of a chop.
- Rock: new one-handed overhand smash.
- Backpack: craft it (50 cloth, 10 leather), wear it in the new BACK slot for 12 more inventory slots.
- Semi, SMG and rifle bodies can be crafted (Components tab). Handmade shells: 5 per craft from gunpowder, metal fragments and stone.
- Revolver and Custom SMG also take handmade shells; waterpipe, double barrel and blunderbuss also take pistol bullets.
- Death screen: 4 second wait before you can respawn.
- Gas station pumps can be broken open for low grade fuel, metal fragments and scrap.
- Helicopters are cheaper: Minicopter 500, Transport 850, Attack 1500.
- Attack helicopter has an inside now.
